title: Debugging Dynamic Class Generation knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Debugging Dynamic Class Generation?
options: It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
reproduce a problem, inspect the built CSS and test output rather than guessing
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
questions.answer_key: reproduce a problem, inspect the built CSS and test output rather than guessing
questions.explanation: Debugging Dynamic Class Generation is best understood through the syllabus topics: Incomplete class strings, Conditional styling problems, Runtime-generated data. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with debugging dynamic class generation?
options: Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
use a minimal test case and confirm the production build and responsive states
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
questions.answer_key: use a minimal test case and confirm the production build and responsive states
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Incomplete class strings, Conditional styling problems, Runtime-generated data, Explicit source registration.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying debugging dynamic class generation?
options: a successful development server does not prove production assets are complete
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
questions.answer_key: a successful development server does not prove production assets are complete
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
